## Should this go upstream?

- [ ] I have considered whether this feature belongs in the [upstream repo](https://github.com/Reloisback/Whiteout-Survival-Discord-Bot) instead. If it is a general improvement to the bot's functionality, please propose it there as well.

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve, or what use case does it enable?

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why you discarded them.

## Additional context

Mockups, links to similar features in other projects, related issues, anything else.
